This relationship is supported by three distinct pathways, each showing a direct link between Oblonganoside C and the inhibitor, with flavopiridol serving as a common mediator. The scores from these pathways indicate a consistent level of confidence in the relationship, though slight variations in scores suggest minor differences in the strength of the evidence. The mechanism appears to involve the inhibition of the target enzyme by flavopiridol, which is likely a general pathway across the different targets of Oblonganoside C. The integration of these pathways highlights the potential of Oblonganoside C as a compound that may interact with the inhibitor through a shared biochemical mechanism, possibly involving the flavopiridol-mediated inhibition of the target enzyme.
